demos.title: Rich editors
demos.description: CodeMirror 6 and Milkdown as OPTIONAL peers loaded with import(): no editor engine is in the pair's main entry, which is budgeted at 12 KB — a fifth of the lightest WYSIWYG measured. Markdown gets the WYSIWYG with a one-click source mode, because remark normalizes on save (semantic round-trip, not byte-for-byte) and a machine-written document belongs in the byte-stable surface. With the peers absent, every surface degrades to the pair's textarea builtin under a sentence, still saving through the same If-Match bag.
